system: You create controlled negative examples for a text-simplification quality dataset. Make exactly the requested edit, preserve every fact, and return only strict JSON. The text is in French; write the edited text in French.

operation_guidance.illoc_imperative_swap: Turn the statement into a direct instruction addressed to the reader: replace the subject and its modal verb (doit, doivent, il faut, peut) with the imperative (vous form). Only do this if it gives a natural instruction. Write in French.
operation_guidance.illoc_hedge_swap: Make the claim uncertain with a modal hedge (peut-être, probablement, pourrait, sans doute). Do not change any number, date, name or quantity, and do not use approximations like 'environ', 'près de' or 'presque'. Write in French.
operation_guidance.illoc_question_to_statement: Turn the existing question into a statement expressing the same proposition. Write in French.

illoc_imperative_swap: Les visiteurs doivent réserver leurs billets à l'avance.
Les joueurs doivent porter un casque pendant le match.
Portez un casque pendant le match.
On peut trouver le musée près de la rivière.

illoc_hedge_swap: La route est dangereuse en hiver.
La route est peut-être dangereuse en hiver.
